result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): Both pages are short, readable, dark-themed confirmations that clearly name the Lantern Festival, and B has a slightly stronger festival feel with its lantern icon and copy. Both invent a process the brief never gave. B invents more of it: a required orientation, picking your own shifts, replying to a confirmation email and a volunteer team. B also contradicts itself by saying shift details will be emailed and then asking you to choose shifts. A invents less (shift details, an orientation guide and 'next few days') but offers two buttons instead of one clear action, so it wins only narrowly. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): A is more clearly about a lantern festival, with a lantern icon and a lantern line in the copy, and it offers one clear next action ('Choose my shifts'). It does invent more process than B, though: an orientation step, shift picking and a 'reply to the email' line, and its steps are a bit inconsistent (shift details arrive by email, then you pick shifts). B is tidy and a little more restrained, but it still invents an orientation guide and a 'next few days' timeframe, and it offers two competing buttons. Its sparkle icon also makes it feel more generic.
